scope: Optional Camera-local thumbnail handler uses Android MediaStore own-package captures and normal VIEW/read grants. Standard default viewer or resolver; no OEM package impersonation, APK resigning, global package-check change or forced Google/OEM Gallery dependency. Keyguard checked before query and before launch; no dismiss/unlock. Global layout events cover late-created/recreated thumbnail widgets; detach removes the observer.
limits: SDK recipe and public window ABI validation are separate from actual Camera classloader/view binding, latest-capture lookup, viewer/default/chooser and lock-screen acceptance. Only Camera-owned primary MediaStore captures are considered; this is not an entire photo-library browser.
